sponsorTasks.title: Sponsor tasks
sponsorTasks.empty: There are no sponsor tasks to review.
sponsorTasks.saved: Saved. Refresh the list to see the latest tasks.
sponsorTasks.unbound: This entry is not yet linked to an account.
sponsorTasks.attempts: Cancel attempts without a confirmed result so far: {count}
sponsorTasks.paidUntil: Paid-until date and time (UTC, as shown in Paddle)
sponsorTasks.evidenceRule: After cancelling in Paddle, record the paid-until date and transaction or adjustment ID. Evidence can be recorded only once and cannot be replaced here.
sponsorTasks.closureRule: Closure is administrative. It ends the operational task, while provider settlement and charge reconciliation continue. Paddle must show the required state before closure.
sponsorTasks.renewingRule: Renewing as a member revokes all linked sponsor entries. It does not promise future individual renewal while an earlier cancellation is unresolved.
sponsorTasks.refundRule: Acknowledgement records that staff reviewed this charge. Any refund decision stays in Paddle.
sponsorTasks.erasureRule: Deletion must use the existing admin erasure process on the linked user page, with the required admin access. This task never deletes an account.

dispositions.renewing_as_member: Paddle shows active with no scheduled change

errors.forbidden: Only staff with a valid tenant and branch can use these tasks.
errors.invalid: Check the IDs, paid-until date and closure outcome.
errors.not_found: This task is no longer available. Refresh the list.
errors.conflict: The task state changed. Refresh and review it.
errors.error: The request could not be completed. Please try again.

conflicts.evidence: Evidence is already recorded, the evidence ID is in use, or this handover no longer accepts evidence. Refresh and review it.
conflicts.close: Paddle does not yet show the required state, or the handover is no longer open. Review Paddle and refresh before trying again.
conflicts.acknowledge: The charge changed. Refresh and review it.

reasons.paddle_state: Paddle needs review. Check the subscription and its handover; record evidence after cancellation or close the handover when Paddle permits.
reasons.empty_interval: The seat would start at or after its end. Review the contract dates and paid-until evidence with the responsible staff.
reasons.binding: The entry could not be bound safely to an account. Review the roster and account identity with the responsible staff.
reasons.unknown: The reason needs staff review. Check the entry before taking action.

intent_review.title: Handover review
intent_review.help: Check Paddle and the member’s instructions. Record paid-until evidence once, or close the handover with a verified Paddle state.

observed_cancel.title: Observed cancellations
observed_cancel.help: Paddle cancellation has been observed. Review the member’s next steps; charge reconciliation continues independently.

scheduled_cancel.title: Scheduled cancellations
scheduled_cancel.help: Paddle has a cancellation scheduled that no sponsored seat needs. Remove it in Paddle only at the member’s request; the system never changes it.

retrying_cancel.title: Cancellations not yet confirmed
retrying_cancel.help: The cancel request was sent at least 5 times without a confirmed result from Paddle. The system keeps retrying and monitoring. Check the subscription in Paddle and contact the member if needed; nothing here changes the handover.

charge.title: Charges to review
charge.help: Review the Paddle transaction and acknowledge it. A charge does not change coverage; refunds are a separate staff decision in Paddle.

entry_review.title: Entries to review
entry_review.help: Review the reason for each held entry and coordinate the required correction.

rejected_entry.title: Overlapping sponsors
rejected_entry.help: This entry was rejected because sponsorships overlap. Commercial handling is a separate owner decision.

checkout_race.title: Individual checkout during sponsorship
checkout_race.help: An active Paddle subscription has no handover while sponsorship covers the person. Review the subscription in Paddle and coordinate with staff.

unactivated_account.title: Unactivated accounts
unactivated_account.help: These accounts have no credential and their last seat ended at least 90 days ago. Review them through the existing admin user and erasure process.
